goal: Prevent descriptor wallets from missing transactions and reporting incorrect balances during rescans
Ensure transactions in the same block that expand the lookahead pool still capture earlier payments
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with master, but the rebase is mechanical and logic can be reviewed now
agreement: Substantive support for fixing the lookahead rescan bug despite double-scan overhead (achow101)
Concept support while pointing out child spends later in the block are still missed (molnard)
Objection that cascading receives beyond the prefix pass are missed, leaving balances short (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes a silent wallet rescan failure where descriptor wallets report incorrect balances
Rescans can silently drop incoming transactions when lookahead pool expansion occurs mid-block
Directly protects recovery correctness for wallet users restoring from descriptors or rescanning
